stars.why: San Antonio is without Dylan Harper (left hip strain, one to three weeks) and Tobias Harris (left calf strain), so more of the offense runs through him, and he has played 33 to 35 minutes in his last three games. New Orleans is on the second night of a back-to-back after Jeremiah Fears, Zion Williamson and Saddiq Bey each played 37 or 38 minutes in Friday's comeback loss at Oklahoma City.

Portland is without Ja Morant, Shaedon Sharpe and Vit Krejci, and Deni Avdija is questionable with a left foot injury.

stars.why: Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), and P.J. Washington and Walter Clayton Jr. are both questionable, so Flagg's load could grow further; he played 34 minutes last time out. The Clippers are missing Bradley Beal and Brandon Ingram.

With Jordan Clarkson out, New York loses its backup scorer at guard, so more of the bench-unit creation falls to Brunson; he has played 34 to 41 minutes in his last three games. OG Anunoby is questionable with left calf tightness.

Jordan Clarkson is out with plantar fasciitis, which leaves Shamet as the main bench guard behind Jalen Brunson; he has played 24 to 30 minutes in his last three games.

Luke Kornet is the backup center behind Victor Wembanyama and has played 13 to 15 minutes in each of his last three games. The injuries to Dylan Harper and Tobias Harris are at guard and forward, so they do not add much to his role.

guide: Pair two or three stars with two or three scrubs, then fill the middle. The scrubs are what make the stars fit under the $50,000 cap.
